**[P1] Keep PR-authored code off the CodeBuild runner**

A `pull_request` workflow runs the PR's workflow definition, allowing a contributor to replace these probe commands and execute arbitrary code on the CodeBuild runner. Restricting `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions does not protect the runner's ambient AWS service-role credentials. The same exposure exists in `ci-toolkit-scripts-probe.yml`. Remove both `pull_request` triggers and use only a trusted push/manual invocation, or a base-branch `pull_request_target` workflow that never executes the head revision.
